messages:
Hannah Ortiz: Dropping the Graphite Edge Figma link and quick asks: editor token clarity, small-multiples chart swatches, table row contrast, and the theme naming + accessibility badge. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/graphite-edge
Marcus Li: First pass looks moody and compact. Two quick nits: link color vs keyword are too similar, and grid lines vanish in condensed tables.
Arjun Mehta: Agreed. Token proposal: keyword #58A9FF, identifier/type #BEEFFF, string #A8E6A2, number #FFB475, function #FFD9A6, comment #6F747A. Move links to warm amber (#FFC86B) to separate from keywords.
Clara Gomez: Charts need strong pairwise separability and colorblind safety. My 6-col draft: #FF6A5C, #4BC8C2, #556BFF, #FFD36B, #9E8EFF, #2F8E5B. Legends at 12px semibold and 10px swatches.
DesignBot: Contrast scan: body 13px = 4.08:1, header 16px bold = 4.9:1, inline-code = 3.65:1. Recommendation: slightly darken code background or increase inline-code weight.
Hannah Ortiz: Let's darken code bg by 6% and add subtle inset border. Quick CSS mock: 
```
/* graphite edge code */
pre, code { background: rgba(10,12,14,0.70); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03); padding: 8px; border-radius:6px; }
.token.keyword { color: #58A9FF; }
.token.string { color: #A8E6A2; }
a, .token.link { color: #FFC86B; }
```
Marcus Li: Chart grayscale test: coral vs amber low contrast. Suggest swapping amber to #FFC86B (higher luminance) or swap coral to slightly darker #E85A4C.
Arjun Mehta: Fine with swapping amber to #FFC86B. Also increase table divider alpha to 0.14 for better row separation at small sizes.
Clara Gomez: UX nit: hover on chart points currently uses large glow. Please switch to 1.5px outline + slight scale up (1.08) - less noisy. Legend truncation: show swatch + short label on mobile.
DesignBot: Colorblind simulation queued. Accessibility badge idea: add small chip next to theme toggle showing 'WCAG AA' or 'Fixes Needed' with tooltip details.
QA-Bot: I'll run snapshot tests and colorblind sims after Figma update. Please ping when uploaded.
Hannah Ortiz: Copy tweak: change menu label from "Dark Mode" to "Graphite Edge (Dark)" so customers can pick variants. Also update focus ring to 2px solid #86BDFF at 60% opacity for keyboard visibility.
Marcus Li: +1. That focus ring is clearer than a shadow-only approach.
Hannah Ortiz: Thanks all, I'll push an updated Figma and tag @DesignBot and @QA-Bot for re-checks. :thumbsup:
